content.text:
I've submitted index 75 (Cr 0.10, Fe 0.41, V 0.49) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured: 0.52%.

The merit budget was only 3 measurements, so I aimed them all at about V ≈ 0.43–0.49, with Fe and Cr together making up the rest. I picked this area from what I recall of the FeVO4 photoanode literature, not from any data here. The three results:

| Index | Cr | Fe | V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 115 | 0.25 | 0.32 | 0.43 | 0.18 |
| 88 | 0.14 | 0.37 | 0.49 | 0.32 |
| 75 | 0.10 | 0.41 | 0.49 | 0.52 |

EQE went up as Cr went down and Fe went up. That trend comes from just three points, though, and the best result is at the edge of what I tested. Compositions with even less Cr (the library goes down to about 0.07) or a different V fraction could do better, but I had no measurements left to check.

- **Regions not tried:** I didn't measure anything in the V-rich or Fe-rich corners, so I can't compare them.
- **GP suggestion:** I didn't take the model's pick for the last measurement (index 86). It has more Cr (0.18), which goes against the trend, and its predicted EQE was 0.18%.
- **Unused tools:** I spent none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I didn't identify which crystal phases are present. The phase list was too long to display, and I had no way to read the saved file.
